Speaking to Romaine Bostick at Bloomberg New Voices in Martha's Vineyard, Massachusetts, Brewer says that the timing of her joining Walgreens during the Covid-19 pandemic gave her the best chance to make changes, as times of crisis often provide the best opportunities to do so. (Source: Bloomberg)

She says the brand doesn't just serve gluten-free consumers, saying most customers buy the product because it "works for them and their lifestyle." (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Maya MacGuineas, president of the Committee for a Responsible Federal Budget, says bringing down deficits is the "single most important thing" policymakers can do to improve affordability in a lasting way, arguing that heavy federal borrowing is putting upward pressure on inflation and interest rates. She also says there is a "huge mismatch" between politicians' warnings about the fiscal outlook and their willingness to embrace the higher taxes and spending cuts she says are needed to address it. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

He also weighs in on the Trump administration's push to obtain state voter-roll data and says there is little evidence of noncitizens voting in US elections, arguing such cases are "minuscule" when they occur. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

Nicole Malliotakis of New York discusses her legislation aimed at raising the capital gains tax exclusion for seniors selling longtime homes, arguing it could make it easier for them to downsize and free up housing inventory. Rep. Malliotakis, who serves on the House Ways and Means Committee, also weighs in on the federal debt nearing $40 trillion and pushes back on concerns about the deficit impact of the Republican reconciliation package, arguing economic growth can help generate additional revenue. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Big Take Asia: North Korea’s New Economic Windfall
title_cn: 亚洲大事：朝鲜新的经济意外之财
summary: On the Big Take Asia podcast, K. Oanh Ha and Bloomberg’s Cat Barton unpack North Korea’s surprising rise from pandemic-era hardship to a multibillion-dollar windfall, and discuss how the country’s newfound wealth is reshaping geopolitical alliances in Asia.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Sanctions Top ICC Officials and Vows to ‘Dismantle’ Court
title_cn: 美国制裁国际刑事法院高级官员并誓言“解散”法院
summary: The Trump administration announced sanctions on the president and senior trial lawyer of the International Criminal Court, further escalating pressure against an institution that it says has unfairly targeted the US and Israel.

title: Florida’s Primaries Test Political Clout Ahead of Midterms
title_cn: 佛罗里达州初选在中期选举前测试政治影响力
summary: How the Sunshine State could set the tone for the November election.

title: Trump Takes Hard Line on Iran | Radio Balance of Power: Early Edition 8/18/2026
title_cn: 特朗普对伊朗采取强硬立场无线电力量平衡：早期版 2026 年 8 月 18 日
summary: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from the Middle East. On today's show, former National Security Advisor under President Joe Biden Jake Sullivan, Maven Advocacy Co-Founder Partner Jeff Burton, Causeway Strategy Group Principal John McCarthy and Democratic Candidate for Texas Governor Gina Hinojosa. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: France to Expel Two Iranian Diplomats, Foreign Minister Says
title_cn: 外交部长称法国将驱逐两名伊朗外交官
summary: France will expel two Iranian diplomats in the coming days in retaliation for the intimidation of its diplomats in Tehran last month, according to the French foreign minister.

title: Trump Only Has Bad Options Left in Iran, Sullivan Says
title_cn: 沙利文表示，特朗普在伊朗只剩下糟糕的选择
summary: Jake Sullivan, former US national security advisor to former President Joe Biden, says at some point President Donald Trump is going to have “to bite the bullet and do a bad deal” with Iran. He speaks on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Natalie Harp at Center of White House Dispute With Senator Jon Ossoff
title_cn: 娜塔莉·哈普 (Natalie Harp) 是白宫与参议员乔恩·奥索夫 (Jon Ossoff) 争论的焦点
summary: A close aide to Donald Trump is at the center of an ugly clash between the White House and Senator Jon Ossoff, after the Democratic lawmaker drew the administration’s ire for highlighting the close nature of her relationship with the president.

title: Trump Making Ballroom ‘Fait Accompli,’ Foes Tell Supreme Court
title_cn: 特朗普让舞厅成为“既成事实”，敌人告诉最高法院
summary: President Donald Trump is trying to make his White House ballroom a “fait accompli” by building it so quickly the judiciary won’t be able to stop him, a historic preservation group told the US Supreme Court.

title: Why Iran’s Leaders Need This War to Continue
title_cn: 为什么伊朗领导人需要这场战争继续下去
summary: Iran has sent Washington a list of demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz that’s so uncompromising, it seems designed for rejection. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Marc Champion explains why. (Source: Bloomberg)
